result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears largely well-structured. A few minor layout issues exist related to text truncation and edge-cut content cards.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, indicating a partially visible card.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal scroll carousel, but ensure the truncation uses an ellipsis and the card peek is intentional to hint at scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off by the viewport/bottom navigation, showing only a partial image with no title or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom padding above the fixed navigation bar so content cards are not awkwardly clipped, or verify scroll reveals full card.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the ramen card is white/outlined on a light overlay while the heart on the pizza card is dark on a dark circular background, showing inconsistent styling.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling (background and color) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
